metadata.title: Classloom
metadata.description: One portal to run your school: admissions, students, staff, attendance, fees, exams and communication.

shell.searchDescription: Jump to any page you have access to.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholderNote: Live figures arrive with the Students & Admissions module.

comingSoon.title: {section} is coming soon
comingSoon.body: This module is on the Classloom roadmap and will be built module by module.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

brand.tagline: One portal to run your school

points.one: Admissions, students, staff and fees in one place
points.two: Set up in minutes, with no installation
points.three: Built for Indian schools and boards

header.title: Register your school
header.subtitle: Create your school on Classloom. It takes about two minutes.

school.title: Tell us about your school
school.description: These details appear on your school profile.

code.title: Choose your school code
code.description: Staff, parents and students type this code to sign in. You can't change it yourself later.

admin.title: Your details
admin.description: You become the school's first administrator. We email you a link to confirm.

fields.codeHint: 3 to 12 letters or digits. Hyphens are allowed between parts.
fields.emailHint: We send the verification link here.

availability.reservedMessage: This code is reserved. Choose another one.
availability.invalidMessage: Use 3 to 12 letters or digits, starting with a letter, with single hyphens between parts.

terms.label: I accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and allow Classloom to process school data as described in the <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>.

actions.haveAccount: Already registered? Sign-in arrives in the next release.

errors.schoolName: Enter the school name (3 to 120 characters).
errors.state: Select a state or union territory.
errors.codeTaken: This school code is already taken.
errors.adminName: Enter your full name (2 to 80 characters).
errors.mobile: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
errors.acceptTerms: Accept the Terms and Privacy Notice to continue.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach Classloom. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We sent a verification link to {email}. It expires in 24 hours.
checkInbox.spam: Can't see it? Check your spam folder.
checkInbox.resendIn: You can ask for another link in {seconds}s.
checkInbox.resendReady: Didn't get it? You can ask for another link.
checkInbox.resent: If that registration is still pending, a new link is on its way.
checkInbox.resendError: We couldn't resend the link. Please try again shortly.
checkInbox.differentEmailError: We couldn't release this registration to change the email. Check your connection and try again.

verify.title: Verify your school
verify.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it manually.
verify.next: Keep this code. Staff, parents and students use it to sign in. Sign-in arrives in the next release.
verify.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
verify.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. If you registered this school, it's ready; sign-in arrives soon. Otherwise, request a new link below.
verify.sent: If those details match a pending registration, a new link is on its way.
verify.errorBody: This looks like a connection problem, not a problem with your link. Try again.

legal.termsBody: These terms are a draft placeholder. The final Terms of Service will be published before Classloom opens to schools.
legal.privacyBody: This notice is a draft placeholder. The final Privacy Notice will explain what school data Classloom processes and why, before Classloom opens to schools.
